Detailed Description

Everything the snicholls libraries share, at the bottom of the stack.

Public names live directly in snicholls, implementation details in snicholls::detail, and the library's own metadata in snicholls::core.

◆ convert_rate()

result< priced_rate, money_errc > snicholls::convert_rate ( const rate & r,
unsigned places,
rounding mode )
nodiscardconstexprnoexcept

A rate priced to places decimal places by mode: a fund's NAV per unit to four places, say.

The same rounding as convert, for the same seven modes, applied to the rate itself: the rounded rate is round(numerator * 10^places / denominator) / 10^places, and the residual what rounding left, exactly. A rate is never negative, so floor rounds as toward_zero and ceiling as away_from_zero.

Parameters
rThe rate.
placesThe decimal places, at most 77.
modeThe rounding mode.
Returns
The rounded rate (same assets) and the residual, or overflow for more than 77 places or a result past 256 bits.
